fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Staff Nurse 2023 Final Result - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Final Result for the Staff Nurse Post. This recruitment was released for 2240 posts. The applications for UPPSC Staff Nurse Recruitment 2023 were accepted from 21 August 2023 to 29 September 2023. The mains examination was held on 28 July 2024. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPPSC Staff Nurse 2023 Final Result from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 August 2023
  • Last Date : 29 September 2023
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 September 2023
  • Exam Date : 19 December 2023
  • Admit Card Available : 08 December 2023
  • Answer Key Available : 22 December 2023
  • Pre Result Available : 20 February 2024
  • Mains Online Form : 28 February 2024 to 14 March 2024
  • Receipt Form Last Date (Hard Copy) : 21 March 2024
  • Mains Exam Date : 28 July 2024
  • Admit Card Available : 24 July 2024
  • Final Result Available : 07 March 2025
  • DV Letter Available : 03 April 2025
  • Final Result : 23 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 125/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
